jobs.description:
At ProService, we exist to empower employers to succeed in Hawai?i. More than 3,000 local businesses rely on us for payroll, HR, and benefits, and many run their day on tools like Toast, QuickBooks Online, and NetSuite. When those systems talk cleanly to ours, a restaurant owner closes payroll without re-keying hours. When they don’t, a small business loses time it doesn’t have.

This role owns that connection. You’ll build and run the integrations marketplace that links our customers’ business systems to our HR platform, blending strong engineering with real product ownership. Success looks like customers connecting in minutes, data that stays accurate without manual work, and problems fixed before anyone has to report them.

**IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL**

* Design, build, and launch integrations with platforms like Toast, QuickBooks Online, and NetSuite using OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and polling
* Own the integrations marketplace end to end, including the catalog, connect and disconnect flows, connection health, and a roadmap prioritized with Product
* Architect reusable serverless patterns on AWS (Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB) in Python, TypeScript, and React/Next.js so each integration ships faster than the last
* Partner directly with customers on bespoke integrations with ProService APIs, and with vendor developer programs on sandbox access, certification, and API changes
* Build monitoring and alerting that catches sync failures before customers notice
* Uphold code quality through testing, code reviews, and CI/CD, and support production reliability through on-call rotations

**IS THIS ROLE RIGHT FOR YOU?**

This is an ownership role, not a ticket queue. You’ll ship at least one production-ready integration per quarter and keep owning it after launch, including joining the on-call rotation to resolve critical issues within hours. You’ll also talk directly with customers and partners to shape what gets built next. These expectations are not optional — they’re the job. You’ll share them with a team that reviews each other’s code and treats incidents as chances to learn, not to assign blame.

The role also takes patience. Partner APIs change, certifications move at their own pace, and many decisions are judgment calls between fast and durable. The team works on Hawai?i Standard Time, so Southern California candidates should expect a workday that starts mid-morning and runs into the early evening.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TEAM**

You’ve shipped production-grade software in a SaaS or product-driven environment, and you’ve built third-party integrations that stay reliable. That means experience with OAuth 2.0 token lifecycle, webhooks, pagination, data mapping, and vendor API versioning. You’re fluent in AWS serverless, Python, TypeScript, React/Next.js, and Git-based Agile workflows. Accounting, POS, time and labor, or payroll familiarity is a strong plus. So is experience with partner certification programs or with AI/LLM APIs for data mapping.

**You’re probably a fit if:**

* **You enjoy the detective work of making systems agree.** *You trace a mismatched record through logs, payloads, and mappings to its root cause, so the customer’s numbers line up every time after.*
* **You make sound calls between fast and durable.** *When an API change collides with a deadline, you weigh a quick patch against a retry-safe fix and choose the path that keeps customer data safe.*
* **You keep your commitments when priorities compete.** *You juggle a new build, a production fix, and a partner certification, and everyone waiting on you knows when their piece is coming.*
* **You adjust quickly when the ground shifts.** *When a vendor deprecates an endpoint mid-sprint, you re-plan and keep customers connected without them noticing.*
* **You translate between technical and non-technical worlds.** *You explain trade-offs in plain language and bring Product, Support, and customers in early, so what you ship solves the real problem.*

**WORK LOCATION**

**Honolulu, Hawaii — Hybrid | Orange County or Los Angeles, CA — Remote**

We welcome applications from candidates based in Hawaii, who would work a hybrid schedule out of our Honolulu office, as well as fully remote candidates based in Orange County or Los Angeles. Hawaii-based candidates are preferred, followed by candidates in Orange County. Remote candidates must be available during Hawaii Standard Time (HST / UTC-10) business hours.

Hawaii (Hybrid): In office Tuesday – Thursday | Option for Remote Monday & Friday  
Southern California (Remote): Hours: Hawaii Standard Time (HST / UTC-10)

The base compensation for this position is $110,000.00 – $137,000.00 per year depending on experience and qualifications.

**WHY PROSERVICE**

ProService is a Hawaii-based PEO combining payroll, HR, and benefits expertise with purpose-built technology — all backed by the best local service in the islands. Backed by Silver Lake and recognized as one of Hawai?i’s Best Places to Work for 20 consecutive years, we’re a team of high performers united by one mission: Empowering Employers to Succeed in Hawaii.

* **A PROhana unlike any other.** We assume the best in each other, give feedback focused on what’s right—not who’s right—and show up every day. This isn’t just a workplace. It’s a community.
* **Do work that matters.** You’ll see exactly how your contributions move the needle—meaningful problems, real decisions, and a seat at the table.
* **Grow without a ceiling.** Internal roles post first, and we reimburse certifications, conferences, and memberships. Your growth is our growth.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Payload Integrations team owns everything that connects to the vehicle beyond the base platform. This includes gimbals and EO/IR sensors, arming and fuzing devices, weapons payloads, radios, and other mission hardware. We build the software and interfaces that enable these payloads to reliably run on the vehicle. Nearly every customer program needs a new or modified payload, which makes this team a critical contributor to nearly everything we ship. Our work goes from the lab bench to hardware-in-the-loop testing to live flight, and it has to work in a variety of demanding operational environments.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Payload Integrations team. You will design, build, and maintain the software that brings new sensors, communications systems, and mission payloads onto our autonomous vehicles. You will work closely with hardware, electrical, autonomy, and systems engineering teams, as well as outside payload vendors, to turn new hardware into dependable, well-tested components of the vehicle. If you are self-motivated, hold yourself to high standards, enjoy working where software meets hardware, and do well in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment, this role is for you.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Design and implement software integrations for gimbals, EO/IR sensors, radios, arming and fuzing devices, and other mission payloads on autonomous vehicles.
* Define and maintain clean, reusable interfaces between payloads and the vehicle software stack, to enable new payloads without changes to autonomy code.
* Work through vendor interface control documents (ICDs), implement device drivers and protocol handlers, and lead hardware bring-up in the lab.
* Build simulation, emulation, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test infrastructure to evaluate payload behavior before flight.
* Support integration events, ground tests, and flight tests, and root-cause issues across software, firmware, and hardware boundaries.
* Partner with program teams to scope, estimate, and deliver payload integrations for customer projects on tight timelines.
* Contribute to the safety-critical software behind arming and weapons-related payloads, with a high bar for rigor, review, and testing.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on embedded systems, robotics, or hardware integration.
* Strong experience with Rust and/or C++, plus working proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience integrating hardware over common interfaces and protocols (e.g., UART/RS-422, CAN, Ethernet/UDP, SPI/I2C).
* Experience reading datasheets and ICDs and turning them into robust software implementations.
* Comfort debugging at the hardware/software boundary using lab equipment and bus/packet analysis.
* Experience developing on Linux-based systems.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, including working with external vendors and cross-functional engineering teams.
* US Persons: Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience integrating gimbals, cameras, EO/IR sensors, or tactical radios and datalinks.
* Familiarity with safety-critical or arming/fuzing systems and related development practices.
* Experience with UAS, missiles, or other aerospace/defense platforms.
* Experience building HIL/SITL test environments or hardware emulators.
* Familiarity with middleware and serialization frameworks (e.g., Protobuf, gRPC, DDS, MAVLink).
* Experience with embedded Linux, real-time systems, or resource-constrained environments.
* Background supporting field integration and flight test campaigns.
* Active U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one.

jobs.description:
Obsidian Systems is a software engineering consultancy that builds production systems for capital markets and other regulated industries. Our clients include market infrastructure providers, national exchanges, and global financial institutions. Much of our work today centers on the Canton Network, the privacy-enabled blockchain adopted by major capital markets institutions, where Obsidian is one of the most experienced engineering firms in the ecosystem.

We're a remote-first, globally distributed team that values ownership, curiosity, and clear communication. We believe the best ideas come from people who ask difficult questions, take responsibility for their work, and collaborate openly to solve challenging problems.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a **Functional Software Engineer** to join our engineering team and contribute to challenging client projects across our technical domains. You'll design, develop, and maintain software using functional programming principles, working with engineers and client teams to turn complex requirements into robust, maintainable solutions. Depending on the project, your work may involve backend systems, domain modelling, distributed systems, financial infrastructure, blockchain applications, or developer tooling.

This role is suited to an engineer who enjoys reasoning about complex systems, values strong types and clear abstractions, and sees software development as more than simply making code work. Knowledge in every technology is not necessary. We value strong engineering fundamentals, a willingness to learn, and the ability to apply sound technical judgment to unfamiliar problems.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, implement, test, and maintain reliable software using functional programming principles.
* Develop clear, composable, and maintainable solutions to complex engineering problems.
* Apply strong typing, domain modelling, and abstraction to improve software correctness and reliability.
* Collaborate with engineers, technical leads, and client stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Contribute to the design and architecture of systems, making thoughtful trade-offs between correctness, simplicity, performance, and maintainability.
* Write automated tests and use appropriate techniques to validate system behaviour.
* Review code, share technical knowledge, and contribute to engineering standards.
* Investigate and resolve complex technical issues across existing systems.
* Communicate technical decisions clearly and explain trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Adapt to different client environments, codebases, and technical challenges.
* Contribute to continuous improvement across our engineering practices, tools, and delivery processes.

**Key Requirements**
--------------------

* 5+ years of professional experience developing and delivering production software.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, and software design.
* Experience with functional programming, either professionally or through substantial projects.
* Ability to reason about complex problems and translate requirements into well-structured software.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Commitment to code quality, correctness, and maintainability.
* Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with other engineers.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and work across different technical environments.

* Experience with Haskell, Scala, OCaml, F#, Clojure, or another functional programming language.

* Experience with Nix or reproducible development environments.

---------------

At Obsidian Systems, we believe great work comes from thoughtful people who take ownership, communicate openly, and enjoy solving difficult problems together. These principles guide how we work every day.

Own Your Work, Protect Your Team

* We take full ownership of our responsibilities while supporting the people around us. We believe accountability creates trust, and clear ownership allows teams to move quickly without stepping on one another's work.
